label: AC wiring schematic - inverter, generator and shoreline
caption: The drawn AC schematic. Three supplies across the top - INVERTER, GENERATOR and SHORELINE, each with line and neutral. Two R.C.C.B units on the inverter side; changeover contactors marked SHORE and GEN below the generator and shoreline. Outgoing circuits at the bottom: SOCKETS 1, SOCKETS 2, SOCKETS 3 and AUX on one bank, CHARGER, IMM HEATER, WASHING MACHINE and HOB on the other, each with its neutrals.

label: Current arrangement (hand-drawn block diagram)
caption: Hand-drawn sheet titled 'Current Arrangement'. Gen and Shoreline feed through a changeover into one RCB serving Charger, Imm heater, Washing machine and Hob. Inverter/charger feeds a second RCB serving Sockets 1, 2 and 3, Aux and Oven.
notes: Hand-drawn and undated. It disagrees with figure 34 of the instruction manual, which shows the inverter/charger fed from the generator and shore rather than sitting on a separate leg. Worth confirming against the boat before relying on either.

label: Proposed arrangement - REJECTED, struck through
caption: Hand-drawn sheet titled 'Proposed Arrangement', showing Gen and Shoreline joining at a single point into one Inverter/Charger which then feeds all circuits. The whole sheet, and its title, are struck through with a heavy red X.
notes: NOT the wiring of the boat. This proposal was crossed out in red on the original sheet, so it was considered and rejected. Kept on record only; excluded from retrieval so it can never be sent as an answer about how Becky is wired.
